articles.title: Chrome again exempts Google from user site data settings
articles.zh: Chrome再次让Google豁免于用户网站数据设置
articles.summary: 如果你运营网站或做隐私合规，这次更新表明Chrome依然给Google自家数据开特例，统计和风控都得单独处理
articles.body:
Six years ago I published a blog post Chrome exempts Google sites from user site data settings that received quite a bit of attention: Michael Tsai , Hacker News The Register , The Verge , and Gizmodo , among others. The blog post was about a Google Chrome bug that mysteriously exempted Google-owned sites from the setting to automatically delete all site data. Eventually, spurred by my report, Google did fix the bug.

You can probably guess why I’m writing about the bug again: I’ve noticed Chrome doing something similar now. I’ve reproduced this new issue on two different Macs with Chrome version 152.0.7977.83. For testing purposes, I changed the default search engine in Chrome from Google to DuckDuckGo, just to make sure that this setting was not the cause.

On-device site data settings ( chrome://settings/content/siteData ) shows that the Default behavior is to Delete data sites have saved to your device when you close all windows.

I’m not signed into Chrome and indeed disallow Chrome sign-in.

You can see on chrome://settings/content/all that no site data is saved.

Now I do a Google search.

Then I close the one and only window in Chrome.

Returning to chrome://settings/content/all , I find some google.com site data! This data persists even if I quit and relaunch Chrome.

If I delete the Google site data and repeat the whole process, the same issue occurs again.

As far as I can tell, www.google.com is the only site exempted by Chrome. Looking inside the ~/Library /Application Support /Google /Chrome /Default folder, it appears that the saved site data consists of Cookies, Local Storage, and Session Storage.

I’m not certain when this issue was introduced. My default web browser is Safari, so I don’t use Chrome full-time, though I do use it (and Firefox) frequently for testing.

I’m personally inclined to cite Hanlon’s razor here rather than engage in conspiracy theories. Nonetheless, Google has no excuse for incompetence either, especially given the amount of money made by the company (which I’ll always call Google, not Alphabet) and its engineers. They can avoid receiving bad publicity from me by improving their QA. Perhaps some kind of unit tests for this feature? Move slower and don’t break things.

I wish the government would move fast and break up the Google Search monopoly. Don’t even get me started about how when you’re not signed in to Google, all Google Search results are now opaque https://www.google.com/goto?url= garbage rather than the site URLs!
articles.bodyZh:
六年前我发过一篇博客，标题是《Chrome 对谷歌自家网站豁免了用户数据设置》，当时引起了不少关注：Michael Tsai、Hacker News、The Register、The Verge、Gizmodo 等媒体都报道过。那篇博客讲的是 Chrome 的一个 bug——它莫名其妙地让谷歌旗下的网站不受“自动删除所有网站数据”这个设置的限制。后来，在我的报告推动下，谷歌确实修掉了这个 bug。

你现在大概能猜到为什么我又要写这个 bug 了：我发现 Chrome 现在又出现了类似的情况。我在两台不同的 Mac 上，用 Chrome 152.0.7977.83 版本复现了这个新问题。为了测试，我把 Chrome 的默认搜索引擎从谷歌换成了 DuckDuckGo，就是为了排除是这个设置导致的可能性。

设备端网站数据设置（chrome://settings/content/siteData）显示，默认行为是“关闭所有窗口时删除网站保存在你设备上的数据”。

我没有登录 Chrome，而且明确禁止 Chrome 登录。

在 chrome://settings/content/all 页面上可以看到，没有任何网站数据被保存。

然后我用谷歌搜索了一下。

接着我关掉了 Chrome 里唯一的一个窗口。

再回到 chrome://settings/content/all，我发现了 google.com 的网站数据！即使我彻底退出并重新打开 Chrome，这些数据依然还在。

如果我删掉这些谷歌网站数据，再重复一遍整个过程，问题还是会再次出现。

据我所知，www.google.com 是唯一被 Chrome 豁免的网站。查看 ~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/Default 文件夹后发现，保存的网站数据包括 Cookies、Local Storage 和 Session Storage。

我不确定这个问题是什么时候出现的。我的默认浏览器是 Safari，所以不会一直用 Chrome，不过我确实经常用 Chrome（以及 Firefox）做测试。

我个人倾向于用“汉隆剃刀”来解释这件事，而不是去搞阴谋论。不过话说回来，谷歌也没有理由这么不靠谱，尤其是考虑到这家公司（我一直叫它谷歌，不叫 Alphabet）和它的工程师们赚了多少钱。他们完全可以改进质量保障，避免从我这里得到负面曝光。也许可以给这个功能加一些单元测试？放慢脚步，别把事情搞砸。

我真希望政府能快点动手，拆掉谷歌的搜索垄断地位。更别提当你没有登录谷歌账号时，所有谷歌搜索结果都变成了那种不透明的 https://www.google.com/goto?url= 垃圾链接，而不是真正的网站 URL——这件事我都不想说。

articles.title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
articles.zh: RoboSPA：VLA模型能否突破简单场景与短时任务的局限？
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人操作或VLA模型评估，这篇给出了一个更难的benchmark，帮你判断自家模型离真实场景还有多远。
articles.author: Zhenxuan Fan, Bo Zhang 等
articles.body: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, existing datasets and benchmarks mainly evaluate task completion under predefined settings, offering limited insight into model reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity. We introduce \textbf{RoboSPA} (\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment), a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models. \texttt{RoboSPA} focuses on two core dimensions, Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning and Long-Horizon Procedural Planning, covering 10 task categories and 56 base tasks. Each task is instantiated across five difficulty levels, yielding 280 variants with increasing spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity. We collect 527K trajectories across multiple embodiments and diverse scenes. Beyond binary success rate, \texttt{RoboSPA} introduces diagnostic metrics for more detailed evaluation. Experiments on representative VLA models show that current systems still struggle with complex spatial relations, precise low-level execution, and memory-intensive planning. These results establish \texttt{RoboSPA} as a challenging diagnostic benchmark for developing more capable, reliable, and generalizable embodied agents. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA.
articles.bodyZh:
视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型在语言条件驱动的机器人操作任务上已经展现出了不错的前景。不过呢，现有的数据集和评测基准，大多都只是在预设好的场景下看任务能不能完成，对于模型在面对越来越复杂的空间关系和操作步骤时，推理能力到底怎么样，其实给不出太多有价值的信息。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了一个叫 RoboSPA 的大规模机器人操作数据集和评测基准，全称是 Robot Spatial-Procedural Assessment，专门用来诊断 VLA 模型在具身推理上的短板。RoboSPA 主要聚焦两个核心维度：一个是细粒度的空间推理能力，另一个是长程的多步骤操作规划能力。整个基准涵盖了 10 大任务类别、56 个基础任务，而且每个任务都设置了五个不同难度的等级，这样算下来一共有 280 个变体，难度梯度就体现在空间上的模糊程度和操作流程的复杂度是层层递进的。

在数据规模上，我们收集了 52.7 万条操作轨迹，数据来自多种不同的机器人本体和丰富的场景设置。而且，RoboSPA 不只是看任务成功没成功，我们还设计了一套诊断性的评估指标，能够更精细化地分析模型到底是在哪一步出了问题。

我们对几个有代表性的 VLA 模型做了实验测试，结果发现，现有的系统在处理复杂空间关系、高精度的底层动作控制，还有非常依赖记忆的长期规划这些方面，依然存在明显的短板。这些结果也证明，RoboSPA 作为一个高难度的诊断基准，能够很好地帮助我们去开发那些能力更强、可靠性更高、泛化性更好的具身智能体。

我们的数据和代码都是开源的，链接是 https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA。

articles.title: Large Language Models for HVAC Operations in Building Energy Systems: A Critical Review of Methods, Applications, and Deployment Readiness
articles.zh: 面向建筑能源系统中暖通空调（HVAC）运维的大语言模型：方法、应用与部署就绪度综述
articles.summary: 如果你在探索LLM落地传统工业场景，这篇冷静梳理了暖通领域用大模型能干什么、现在还撑不起什么。
articles.author: Alexander Neubauer, Tianzhen Hong 等
articles.body: Building automation systems generate rich sensor data yet remain insight-poor because heterogeneous point naming, missing metadata, and fragmented documentation obstruct their operational use. This systematic review analyses and codes 66 peer-reviewed studies on large language models (LLMs) for HVAC operations published between 2023 and March 2026. Each study is classified across five application families and three LLM method families and assessed for evidence realism, deployment readiness, and the responsibility boundary between the LLM and physical HVAC decisions. The corpus is concentrated in building energy modelling (BEM, 32 of 66 papers), while load forecasting remains too sparse for subfield-level conclusions. Only four studies reach pilot-level evidence, and none reports sustained operational deployment. No study was classified as ready-now for industry adoption; three were near-term and 63 research-only. Nevertheless, several bounded, human-in-the-loop uses merit near-term trials, including point-name normalisation, document-grounded operator support, BEM workflow assistance, and advisory interfaces around physics-based controllers. Conventional machine learning (ML), model predictive control (MPC), reinforcement learning (RL) and ontology-based tools remain more adopted for high-frequency control, short-horizon numerical forecasting, and well-posed ontology mapping, while autonomous agentic operation and unvalidated occupant proxies remain research-stage. Current evidence therefore supports LLMs primarily as semantic and workflow layers rather than autonomous HVAC controllers. Future work should prioritise field-validated benchmarks, orchestration evaluation under operational constraints, and LLM-MPC/RL architectures with bounded latency and verifiable safety properties.
articles.bodyZh:
楼宇自动化系统虽然能采集到海量的传感器数据，但真正能用的信息却少得可怜——症结在于设备点的命名五花八门、元数据缺失、文档支离破碎，导致这些数据在实际运维中根本派不上用场。这篇系统性综述梳理并编码了2023年至2026年3月间发表的66篇同行评审研究，这些研究聚焦于将大语言模型（LLM）应用于暖通空调（HVAC）系统的运维。每项研究都被归入五个应用族和三个LLM方法族，并逐一评估了其证据真实性、落地部署成熟度，以及LLM与物理HVAC决策之间的责任边界。

从语料分布来看，研究高度集中在建筑能耗建模（BEM，66篇论文中占32篇），而负荷预测领域的研究则少得可怜，还不足以支撑子领域的总结性结论。证据强度方面，只有4项研究达到了试点级别，没有任何一项报告了持续性的实际运维部署。按落地成熟度划分，没有一项研究被判定为"现在就能产业化"，3项属于近期可落地，其余63项都停留在纯研究阶段。不过，仍然有一些界限明确、有人类参与闭环的使用场景值得近期开展试点，包括设备点名称规范化、基于文档的运维助手、BEM工作流辅助，以及围绕基于物理模型的控制器提供咨询式交互界面。

相比之下，传统机器学习（ML）、模型预测控制（MPC）、强化学习（RL）和基于本体的工具在高频控制、短时域数值预测和条件明确的本体映射方面仍然更成熟、更被广泛采用；而自主智能体式的运维操作和未经验证的 occupant 代理（以人行为代表的替代指标）目前仍停留在研究阶段。因此，现有证据支持将LLM主要定位为"语义层和工作流层"的角色，而非自主的HVAC控制器。未来的研究应该优先推进现场验证的基准测试、在真实运维约束下的编排评估，以及具有有限延迟和可验证安全属性的LLM-MPC/RL混合架构。

articles.title: How Does mHC Use Its Residual Streams? Selective Routing and Near-Identity Mixing
articles.zh: mHC如何利用残差流？选择性路由与近恒等混合机制
articles.summary: 如果你在做模型可解释性或想理解新型架构的内部信息流，这篇拆解了mHC残差流的两种典型用法。
articles.author: Pengxiang Zhao, Xing Li 等
articles.body: Hyper-Connections and their manifold-constrained variant mHC widen a residual pathway from one stream to n, yet how trained models use this capacity remains unclear: how broadly blocks read and write, how strongly the residual pathway mixes streams, and whether the streams carry distinct representations. We examine these properties in the four-stream residual pathway of DeepSeek-V4-Flash using effective stream counts, cross-stream residual weights, and inter-stream cosine similarity. Read/write routing is concentrated but varies across depth: a typical attention or FFN site effectively uses about two streams, while the dominant stream changes across layers and the representations remain directionally distinct. Residual mixing is modest and occurs primarily in early layers; in layers 22-42, the pathway mostly carries each stream forward separately. Targeted interventions establish the functional significance of these patterns. Replacing the late mixers by identity increases C4 perplexity by only 1.9% and preserves the six-task average score, whereas replacing the early mixers increases perplexity by 41%. Fixing each early mixer to its C4 diagnostic mean increases perplexity by only 0.2% and reduces the average score by 0.25 percentage points, showing that its site-specific structure matters more than its token-wise variation on the evaluated metrics. Likewise, retaining the three largest routing weights per token at every site increases perplexity by at most 2.7% and changes the average score by at most 0.4 points. Thus, the studied model realizes only part of the flexibility afforded by four-stream mHC: individual blocks rarely require all four streams, and late residual mixing provides little measured benefit.
articles.bodyZh: 超连接（Hyper-Connections）和它的流形约束变体 mHC，能把一条残差通路从单流扩成 n 流。但问题是，训练出来的模型到底怎么用这个能力的，现在还不清楚：模块的读写范围有多广？残差通路混合各流的强度有多大？各流是不是真的在携带不同的表示？这篇研究拿 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的四流残差通路开刀，用有效流数、跨流残差权重和流间余弦相似度这几个指标来考察。结果发现，读写的路由分布很集中，但会随网络深度变化：一个典型的注意力或前馈网络（FFN）位置实际上只用大约两条流，而占主导的流在不同层之间会切换，各流表示的方向性差异始终存在。残差混合的幅度不大，主要发生在早期层；在第 22 到 42 层，通路基本上是各流自己走自己的。定向干预实验进一步验证了这些模式的功能意义。把后期的混合器换成恒等映射，C4 困惑度只涨了 1.9%，六个任务的平均分基本不变；但换掉早期的混合器，困惑度直接飙升 41%。把每个早期混合器固定成它在 C4 诊断数据上的均值，困惑度只增加 0.2%，平均分只降 0.25 个百分点——说明在这些评估指标上，位置特定的结构比逐 token 的变化更重要。同样，每个位置只保留每 token 路由权重最大的三个，困惑度最多只增加 2.7%，平均分变化最多 0.4 分。所以，这个被研究的模型其实只兑现了一部分四流 mHC 提供的灵活性：单个模块很少需要全部四条流，而后期的残差混合带来的可测量收益也微乎其微。

articles.title: LexFlip: A Dissociation Diagnostic for Legal Meaning Preservation Metrics
articles.zh: LexFlip：面向法律语义保持指标的解离诊断方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做法律AI的翻译或摘要评估，这个诊断工具能帮你戳穿那些分数好看但语义其实跑偏的指标。
articles.author: Gaurab Baral
articles.body: Does a simplified legal clause still say what the original said? The checks in current use cannot establish that it does: requiring an identical pair to score highest and an unrelated pair lowest moves lexical overlap and legal force together, so any monotone function of token overlap satisfies both. Our remedy is a dissociation, an item holding surface form fixed while legal force moves. We release LexFlip, 373 minimal perturbations of Quebec statutory French that reverse legal force while preserving 0.93 of the tokens, with a harness scoring metrics, regressors and prompted judges alike. The seven embedding and BERTScore metrics we test spend only 0.022 to 0.039 of their identical-to-unrelated range on such an edit, against 0.670 for bidirectional NLI, the one family the identical-pair check would disqualify. On FrJudge, against a measured human ceiling of r=0.597, a bare length feature outscores every semantic metric and has the lowest margin we measure.
articles.bodyZh: 简化后的法律条文，意思还跟原来一样吗？现在常用的那些校验方法，其实根本证明不了这一点：因为它们要求“两份文本必须一模一样才算分最高，毫无关联才算分最低”，这就等于把字面重合度和法律效力绑在了一块儿。于是，只要是随着词元（token）重合度单调变化的打分函数，都能通过这个测试。我们的解决办法是把这两者拆开——让文本表面完全不变，但法律效力发生变化。我们发布了LexFlip数据集，里面包含373个对魁北克法语法规的最小扰动样本，它们能反转法律效力，同时保留93%的词元。我们还配套了一个测试框架，可以评估各种评分指标、回归模型，以及提示式大模型裁判。在我们测试的七种嵌入向量（embedding）和BERTScore指标里，面对这种改动，它们只花了“相同文本到完全无关文本”这个区间里的0.022到0.039的分数差；而双向NLI（bidirectional NLI）这一族模型则花了0.670——也正因如此，那类“要求完全一致得分最高”的测试才会把它排除掉。在FrJudge基准上，对照人工判断上限r=0.597，一个只依赖长度的简单特征居然超过了所有语义指标，而且我们测出的差距也是最小的。

articles.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
articles.zh: RISE：通过自外推策略蒸馏实现递归式改进
articles.summary: 如果你在训练推理模型又苦于数据不够，这个自我蒸馏+自外推的递归训练套路可能是个低成本的提效思路。
articles.author: Yang Li, Semih Yavuz 等
articles.body: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense, per-token supervision for language model post-training, but its effectiveness is bottlenecked by teacher quality: external teachers suffer from distribution mismatch, while self-distillation with privileged conditioning is limited by in-context learning capacity. We propose \textbf{RISE} (\textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{I}mprovement via \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{E}xtrapolating Policy Distillation), which constructs a synthetic teacher directly from the model's own RLVR training trajectory. By extrapolating the displacement between the current checkpoint and a trailing anchor---in parameter space or output logit space---RISE converts a sparse outcome-induced parameter update into a dense token-level target, without any external model or privileged conditioning. RISE combines RLVR and OPD in a complementary loop: outcome rewards ground the extrapolation toward correct reasoning, while the extrapolated teacher refines token-level decisions. Moreover, since the teacher is refreshed every iteration as the student improves, distillation becomes a recursive improvement mechanism rather than a one-shot compression step. Experiments spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-domain STEM, code generation, and multi-turn agentic tasks show that RISE outperforms RLVR-only training and on-policy self-distillation across all settings.
articles.bodyZh: 同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation，OPD）虽然能在语言模型后期训练中提供很密集的token级监督，但它真正的效果，卡在教师模型本身的质量上。外部的教师模型容易产生分布不匹配（distribution mismatch）的问题；而让模型自己对齐自己，再加上特权条件（privileged conditioning）做蒸馏，又会被上下文学习能力限制住。所以我们提出RISE（递归式自我外推策略蒸馏，Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation），思路很直接：只用这个模型自己的RLVR训练轨迹，就能合成一个教师模型。做法是看当前检查点和一个滞后的锚点之间，不管在参数空间还是输出logit空间里，发生了多大的位移，把这个位移外推一步，原本那种稀疏的、只能由结果信号驱动的参数更新，就能变成稠密的、逐token级别的学习目标。整个过程完全不需要外部模型，也不靠特权条件。RISE把RLVR和OPD接成了一个互相帮衬的闭环：结果奖励给外推提供了方向感，让它往正确推理上走；而外推出来的教师模型，再把token层面的决策一点一点抠细。更重要的是，每次迭代，学生模型进步一点，这个教师模型也会同步刷新一次版本，所以蒸馏在这里就不再是“压缩一次就完事”，而是变成了一个能递归提升的持续改进机制。在数学推理、多领域STEM、代码生成以及多轮智能体任务上，RISE的表现都全面超过了只用RLVR训练，以及同策略自我蒸馏。

articles.title: Beyond Aggregate Scores: Behavioral Correctness Assumptions for Assessing Reference-Based Automatic Evaluation Methods
articles.zh: 超越聚合分数：用于评估基于参考的自动评测方法的"行为正确性假设"
articles.summary: 如果你平时靠BLEU或GPT打分来挑模型，这篇提醒你先验证评测指标的行为假设是否成立，否则高分也可能代表“病”。
articles.author: Maria Mahbub, Ashley Rice 等
articles.body: Automated reference-based evaluation methods play a critical role in assessing natural language generation systems. Existing meta-evaluation primarily measures agreement with human judgments or benchmark labels, providing limited insight into evaluator behavior under controlled conditions. We introduce behavioral correctness assumptions, a complementary framework for evaluating reference-based automatic evaluation methods. We define a taxonomy of correctness-preserving and correctness-altering assumptions and operationalize them through controlled response transformations that specify expected scoring behaviors. We evaluate diverse lexical, character-level, semantic, LLM-based, and hybrid evaluators and analyze their assumption-level behavior, stability, sensitivity, repeat-run variability, configuration sensitivity, and reproducibility. Our experiments reveal distinct behavioral trade-offs across evaluation paradigms: no evaluator satisfies all proposed correctness assumptions, and evaluators with similar aggregate performance can exhibit substantially different behavioral profiles. These findings demonstrate that behavioral correctness assumptions provide diagnostic information obscured by conventional aggregate meta-evaluation.

articles.title: GUT: Quantifying and Optimizing the Reasoning Uncertainty of LLMs via Graph Complexity
articles.zh: GUT: 通过图复杂度量化和优化大语言模型的推理不确定性
articles.summary: 如果你关心LLM在复杂推理时的不确定性问题，这篇用图复杂度提供了新的量化工具和优化切入点。
articles.author: Shuang Liang, Xin-Yu Hu 等
articles.body: Recent years have witnessed great advances in the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the reasoning processes of LLMs often exhibit uncertainty, where LLMs often produce a proliferation of divergent branches at each reasoning step even when fed the same prompting inputs, and certain branches exhibit evidently incredible, even nonsensical, reasoning chains and results. In this paper, we propose the Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty (GUT) method for investigating the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs. The key idea of GUT is to characterize the potential branches of each reasoning chain with a directed acyclic graph, thereby ensuring that all potential branches are comprehensively covered within the graph space. Building upon this recognition, we further build two modules of GUT, that is, a Quantification (GUT-Q) module and an Optimization (GUT-O) module, for quantifying and reducing the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs, respectively. GUT-Q measures LLM reasoning uncertainty by approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity. GUT-O implements uncertainty optimization by treating negative uncertainty as the reward function in reinforcement learning. Experimental results conducted on four LLMs and five datasets validate the effectiveness of GUT.
articles.bodyZh: 近几年，大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力取得了巨大进步。不过，LLM 的推理过程常常带着不确定性——哪怕给一模一样的提示词，模型在每一步推理时也会蹦出好多条分叉路子，其中有些分支得出的推理链和结果明显离谱，甚至压根说不通。针对这个问题，我们提出了一种叫 GUT 的方法，全称是“基于图复杂度的不确定性度量”（Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty），用来研究 LLM 的推理不确定性。GUT 的核心思路是：把每条推理链可能出现的分支用一个“有向无环图”来表示，这样一来，所有可能的分支都能被完整地覆盖在这个图空间里。基于这个思路，我们又搭了两个模块：一个是量化模块（GUT-Q），负责给 LLM 的推理不确定性打分；另一个是优化模块（GUT-O），负责降低这种不确定性。GUT-Q 的做法是，用图复杂度去逼近推理空间的复杂度，从而衡量推理不确定性；GUT-O 呢，则是把“负不确定性”当成强化学习里的奖励函数，来实现不确定性优化。我们在四个 LLM 和五个数据集上做了实验，结果验证了 GUT 是有效的。

articles.title: Testing Interchangeability in LLM Agent Teams
articles.zh: LLM Agent团队中的模型可互换性测试
articles.summary: 如果你在搭多Agent系统并考虑换更便宜或更新的模型，这篇告诉你什么时候换掉某个Agent不会拖垮整个团队。
articles.author: Jianxin Gao, Tianyi Yu 等
articles.body: Production multi-agent systems replace agents constantly, on the assumption that an agent filling a role is interchangeable with any other agent that can do the job. We test that assumption. Eight teams per setting are formed independently from one base model on the same tasks, each agent keeping a private notebook across ten formation episodes; we then trade role-matched agents between teams and measure what changes on held-out tasks. Against a placebo that reproduces the disruption of a roster change without changing who occupies the seat, a swap costs little in task score but raises the communication a team spends per unit of progress by 16 to 63 percent, and in Hanabi a swapped agent is more expensive than an inexperienced one, consistent with interference from conventions learned with its former partner. In Collab-Overcooked, when the agent that sets the agenda is replaced, most of the extra communication comes from the agent that stayed. Three ablations, over base models, decoding temperature and formation length, move the swap penalty alongside one other quantity: how far independently formed teams drift apart. Greedy decoding lowers both; doubling a team's history raises both. In these settings, agents are more fungible in task outcome than in coordination efficiency, with larger swap effects after longer formation histories.
articles.bodyZh:
生产环境中的多智能体系统会不停地更换智能体，理由是：一个角色岗位上的智能体，和任何一个能干同样活的智能体都能互换。我们就是要检验这个假设。每种设定下，我们都从同一个基础模型出发，独立组建八支队伍，让它们干同样的任务；每个智能体在十个“组建回合”（formation episode）里都随身记一本私人笔记。接下来，我们把不同队伍里角色匹配的智能体互相调换，看看在那些没参加过组建的任务上会发生什么变化。

对照组是个“安慰剂”（placebo），它会让你感觉像换过人、有那种“阵容变动”的干扰，但实际上坐在那个位置上的根本没换。跟这个对照比，换人本身几乎不损失任务得分，可队伍每推进一个单位所花的通信成本却涨了16%到63%。而且在花火（Hanabi）这个游戏里，调换进来的智能体比完全没经验的新手还要“贵”，这个现象和它从前搭档那边学来的“默契”产生了干扰，刚好对得上。

在合作版《煮糊了》（Collab-Overcooked）里面，如果被换掉的是那个负责定方向的智能体，那多出来的通信量，大部分其实来自留下来的那个智能体。

三个消融实验（ablation）分别改了基础模型、解码温度（decoding temperature）和组建时长，结果显示：换人带来的代价，始终跟另一个指标一起变——就是独立组建的队伍各自“飘”了多远。贪婪解码（greedy decoding）会让这两者一起下降；而把队伍的历史长度翻倍，就会让它们一起上升。

在所有这些设定里，智能体在任务结果上可以说挺“能替”的，但一到协作效率上就没那么能替了；而且队伍一起磨合的时间越长，换人造成的影响就越大。
